mapper.select: SELECT m.acceptor_id AS user_id, COUNT(*) AS score FROM t_mission m JOIN t_user u ON u.id = m.acceptor_id AND u.status = 1 WHERE m.status = 3 AND m.acceptor_id > #{afterId} GROUP BY m.acceptor_id ORDER BY m.acceptor_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COALESCE(reputation, 6000) FROM t_user WHERE id = #{userId} AND status = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_user u JOIN t_mission m ON m.acceptor_id = u.id AND m.status = 3 WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.status = 1
SELECT id AS user_id, username, realm FROM t_user WHERE status = 1 AND id IN #{id}
